regions.today: Sunny spells with showers this afternoon and evening, with some showers turning heavy in the southeast at times and the chance of isolated thunderstorms, in light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry with clear spells at first. Cloud will increase from the south overnight with isolated showers across the south. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 6 degrees in light or variable easterly breezes allowing for mist and fog patches to set in.
regions.tomorrow: Lingering mist and fog will burn off giving way to a mostly cloudy day with sunny or brighter spells breaking through at times through the day with scattered showers developing. Highest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in light to moderate easterly winds.
